messages:
maria: Heads up — new npm package export changes in sdk v2.3.0 are breaking our edge sample app on Cloudflare Workers. stack trace below.
jonah: ugh — repro steps?
maria: clone repo, `npm i @redwood/sdk@2.3.0` then `wrangler dev` fails with `ReferenceError: exports is not defined` in node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.cjs
kevin: can you paste package.json `exports` snippet?
maria:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./edge": {
    "browser": "./dist/edge.mjs",
    "node": "./dist/edge.cjs"
  }
}
```
sam: edge runtimes don't support CJS — Workers picks the first conditional it understands; maybe it chooses `require`?? weird.
jonah: Cloudflare/Worker resolver looks at `browser`/`import`/`default` order; If `edge.mjs` exists but package uses conditional keys ordering, bundler might pick wrong subpath. Also typings won't map to ESM if `types` missing.
maria: types are in `dist/index.d.ts` but not referenced under `exports` — tsc can't find types for `./edge` subpath.
kevin: quick fix: add `"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"` at top-level and expand exports subpath for types:
```json
"./edge": {
  "types": "./dist/edge.d.ts",
  "import": "./dist/edge.mjs",
  "node": "./dist/edge.cjs"
}
```
sam: can confirm that worked locally with `wrangler dev` :thumbsup:
pkgbot: Note: published @redwood/sdk@2.3.1 with proposed change — rollback planned if regression.
jonah: we should update onboarding docs and sample apps — they still `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/sdk'` and expect CJS semantics.
maria: propose adding CI check in devex repo: run sample apps in node+cloudflare bundler on each release.
kevin: also add a quick note in changelog about conditional `exports` ordering and edge compat.
sam: I'll open PRs for sample apps + docs. assigning to @sam
maria: thanks team
